verdict.rationale: Viam's CLI supports deleting data and filtering/tagging data for deletion (viam-docs-23/33), which gives some data deletion control, but there is no evidence of a documented data retention policy, configurable retention windows, automated expiry, or export/deletion tied to specific AI-native consent/audit workflows. missing for 10: documented retention policy settings, automated data expiration/lifecycle rules, org-wide data governance controls, and independent confirmation that deletion is enforced end-to-end.
